# T-2: Filter T-pending-spec from gate evaluation input

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Exclude placeholder task T-pending-spec from the task list passed to gate evaluation so it does not trigger task-single-responsibility failures

## Acceptance Criteria
- When flow.json.tasks contains only T-pending-spec, gate-spec evaluates an empty task list for task-single-responsibility
- When flow.json.tasks contains real tasks plus T-pending-spec, only real tasks are evaluated

## Implementation Notes
Add filtering in run-gate.js where tasks are read from flow state for evaluation. Filter by task id === 'T-pending-spec'.

## Test Strategy
Unit test: verify T-pending-spec is excluded from gate evaluation input. Integration: run gate on a spec with T-pending-spec and verify no task-single-responsibility failure.
